findings.message: Message start event "Msg start" has no message name.
findings.suggestion: Set a message name — Camunda 8 refuses to deploy an unnamed message reference.

findings.message: "Timer start" has 1 event definition(s) without an id.
findings.suggestion: Give every event definition an id (e.g. <ElementId>_TimerEventDefinition) — Zeebe rejects a definition without one.
Set a job type — Camunda 8 refuses to deploy a task with no task definition.

findings.message: "Send no type" (sendTask) has no zeebe:taskDefinition type.
findings.suggestion: Set a job type — Camunda 8 refuses to deploy a task with no task definition.

findings.message: "Rule none" (businessRuleTask) has neither a zeebe:taskDefinition type nor a zeebe:calledDecision.
findings.suggestion: Set a decisionId or a job type.

findings.message: Call activity "Call none" has no zeebe:calledElement processId.
findings.suggestion: Set the process id to call.

findings.message: Message catch "Catch no corr" (intermediateCatchEvent) has no zeebe:subscription correlationKey.
findings.suggestion: Set a correlation key — required for every message catch in Camunda 8.

findings.message: "Catch no id" has 1 event definition(s) without an id.
findings.suggestion: Give every event definition an id (e.g. <ElementId>_TimerEventDefinition) — Zeebe rejects a definition without one.

findings.message: Message catch "Receive no corr" (receiveTask) has no zeebe:subscription correlationKey.
findings.suggestion: Set a correlation key — required for every message catch in Camunda 8.

findings.message: Message catch "bm" (boundaryEvent) has no zeebe:subscription correlationKey.
findings.suggestion: Set a correlation key — required for every message catch in Camunda 8.

findings.message: Timer start event "Timer start" has no timer value; set one of timeCycle, timeDate.
Message intermediate catch event "Catch ext corr" carries its zeebe:subscription itself; Camunda Modeler expects it on message "M1".
findings.suggestion: Move the zeebe:subscription onto the bpmn:message.

findings.message: Receive task "Receive no msg" references no message.
findings.suggestion: Reference a bpmn:message with a name.

findings.message: Message boundary event "bmk" carries its zeebe:subscription itself; Camunda Modeler expects it on message "M3".
findings.suggestion: Move the zeebe:subscription onto the bpmn:message.
